### `mt-eval contest rank`

Provisional ranking of a contest's entries: primary metric (--metric | metadata.primary_metric | chrF++), best first in its own direction → chrF++ → BLEU → COMET → earliest submission; adjacent pairs tested (per-segment AR → CI overlap → point equality) and non-significant pairs share a rank (1,1,3). Read-only; never prompts for a login

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `contest_id` | Contest id — the --slug given to `contest prepare` (`mt-eval contest list` shows it) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--metric` | `METRIC` |  | Override the ranking metric for THIS view: any rankable registry metric (`chrf` = plain chrF) (the recorded metadata.primary_metric is what `close` freezes) |
| `--include-unverified` | switch |  | Rank trust=unverified (self-reported) cards too. Default is VERIFIED-ONLY (the public rules promise it); hidden cards are counted in a banner and the choice is recorded as trust_policy |
| `--tie-test` | one of: `ar`, `bootstrap` |  | Per-segment paired test for adjacent pairs: ar = approximate randomization (Riezler & Maxwell 2005); bootstrap = Koehn 2004 sign-flip (a conservative heuristic, not a true ASL). Used only when BOTH cards carry complete run_card_entries. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.tie_test, else ar — a frozen test cannot be replaced from the command line |
| `--n-resamples` | `N_RESAMPLES` |  | Resampling trials for the paired test. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.n_resamples, else 1000 (only MORE resamples may be requested against a frozen policy) |
| `--alpha` | `ALPHA` |  | Significance level. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.alpha, else 0.05 (only a SMALLER alpha may be requested against a frozen policy) |
| `--seed` | `SEED` |  | RNG seed for the paired test. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.seed, else 12345 (a frozen seed is the reproducibility promise and cannot be changed here) |
| `--no-segments` | switch |  | Skip run_card_entries entirely: ties fall to CI overlap → point equality (what sealed contests get anyway) |
| `--node-verdicts` | `NODE_VERDICTS` |  | Signed verdicts file from `mt-eval node verdicts` (a SEALED contest's paired tests, computed on the organizer node over the sealed references). Used as rung-1 evidence for adjacent pairs; refused unless it verifies and matches this contest's metric and frozen tie policy |
| `--verify-key` | `VERIFY_KEY` |  | The node's score-sign PUBLIC key (.pub.json) that --node-verdicts must verify against |
| `--phase` | one of: `practice`, `evaluation`, `post-evaluation`, `all` |  | Which contest phase to rank. Default: the 'evaluation' phase when the contest's entries declare phases at all, every entry otherwise. A 'practice' ranking is a rehearsal and is labelled not-freezable |
| `--track` | one of: `constrained`, `unconstrained` |  | Show only this entry track. Tracks are ALWAYS ranked separately (a constrained system is never ranked against an unconstrained one); this only narrows the view, and the filtered entries are listed under exclusions with the reason |
| `--include-contrastive` | switch |  | Also print the contrastive section (entries a team submitted as NOT their primary). Contrastive entries are always present in --json/CSV; they are never ranked against primaries and never win |
| `--reveal-identities` | switch |  | Show declared identities on a contest that promised metadata.anonymize_until_close. Permitted only when you OWN the contest AND it is already closed (the promise expires at close) — otherwise pass --i-am-the-organizer to assert standing, which is recorded in identity_policy.source. Email-shaped values are masked either way |
| `--i-am-the-organizer` | switch |  | Assert organizer standing for --reveal-identities on a contest that is still open (the harness cannot verify this from outside the database, so it is recorded rather than trusted silently) |
| `--json` | switch |  | Emit the ranking as JSON on stdout (banners go to stderr) — the same shape `close` freezes and `export` emits |

### `mt-eval contest close`

Close a contest you own and FREEZE its ranking (one-way: open → closed; intake shuts). Ranks on the RECORDED primary metric only, refuses while intake work is in flight (--force), shows the table and asks before writing metadata.final_ranking

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `contest_id` | Contest id — the --slug given to `contest prepare` (`mt-eval contest list` shows it) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-verdicts` | `NODE_VERDICTS` |  | Signed verdicts file from `mt-eval node verdicts` (a SEALED contest's paired tests, computed on the organizer node over the sealed references). Used as rung-1 evidence for adjacent pairs; refused unless it verifies and matches this contest's metric and frozen tie policy |
| `--verify-key` | `VERIFY_KEY` |  | The node's score-sign PUBLIC key (.pub.json) that --node-verdicts must verify against |
| `--force` | switch |  | Close even with intake submissions still in flight (they stay listed under pending_intake, unranked) |
| `--yes`, `-y` | switch |  | Skip the confirmation prompt (scripted closes) |
| `--reveal-identities` | switch |  | Freeze the ranking with declared identities (the default: metadata.anonymize_until_close promises anonymity UNTIL close, and this is the close). Email-shaped values stay masked either way |
| `--no-reveal-identities` | switch |  | Freeze the ranking with pseudonyms instead of declared identities — the entrants stay unnamed in the permanent record |
| `--include-unverified` | switch |  | Rank trust=unverified (self-reported) cards too. Default is VERIFIED-ONLY (the public rules promise it); hidden cards are counted in a banner and the choice is recorded as trust_policy |
| `--tie-test` | one of: `ar`, `bootstrap` |  | Per-segment paired test for adjacent pairs: ar = approximate randomization (Riezler & Maxwell 2005); bootstrap = Koehn 2004 sign-flip (a conservative heuristic, not a true ASL). Used only when BOTH cards carry complete run_card_entries. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.tie_test, else ar — a frozen test cannot be replaced from the command line |
| `--n-resamples` | `N_RESAMPLES` |  | Resampling trials for the paired test. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.n_resamples, else 1000 (only MORE resamples may be requested against a frozen policy) |
| `--alpha` | `ALPHA` |  | Significance level. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.alpha, else 0.05 (only a SMALLER alpha may be requested against a frozen policy) |
| `--seed` | `SEED` |  | RNG seed for the paired test. Default: the contest's frozen metadata.seed, else 12345 (a frozen seed is the reproducibility promise and cannot be changed here) |
| `--no-segments` | switch |  | Skip run_card_entries entirely: ties fall to CI overlap → point equality (what sealed contests get anyway) |

### `mt-eval contest export`

Export a contest's ranking: the FROZEN metadata.final_ranking snapshot for a closed contest (verbatim), or a live ranking labelled provisional for an open one

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `contest_id` | Contest id — the --slug given to `contest prepare` (`mt-eval contest list` shows it) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | one of: `json`, `csv` | `json` | json (the full ranking dict) or csv (one row per entry: the main set, then the contrastive section, then other sets — with rank_min/rank_max, is_primary, track, phase, prize_eligible and the byline as submitter_label_or_pseudonym). Default json |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  | Write to this path instead of stdout |
| `--metric` | `METRIC` |  | Open contests only: rank the provisional export on this metric |
| `--include-unverified` | switch |  | Open contests only: include self-reported cards in the provisional export |
| `--no-segments` | switch |  | Open contests only: skip per-segment evidence |
| `--phase` | one of: `practice`, `evaluation`, `post-evaluation`, `all` |  | Open contests only: which phase the provisional export covers (default: 'evaluation' when entries declare phases, every entry otherwise) |
| `--track` | one of: `constrained`, `unconstrained` |  | Open contests only: export a single entry track (tracks are ranked separately regardless) |

### `mt-eval contest select-for-human-eval`

Allocate a human-evaluation BUDGET over a closed contest's frozen ranking: the top-N primary entries per declared track, keeping a tie group whole when the budget line falls inside it (so the selection may exceed the budget — both numbers are reported). Records NO judgment: ratings are the Speaker Validation lane, which does not exist yet

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `contest_id` | Contest id — the --slug given to `contest prepare` (`mt-eval contest list` shows it) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` |  | **Required.** How many systems per track the human campaign can afford (≥ 1) |
| `--no-keep-tie-groups` | switch |  | Cut hard at the budget even when that splits a tie group the significance test could not separate (default: keep the group whole and report the overrun) |
| `--json` | switch |  | Emit the selection as JSON on stdout |
| `--write` | switch |  | Write it to contests.metadata.human_eval_selection (owner only; allowed only after close — the migration 074 guard enforces the same rule) |

## `mt-eval node`

Organizer scoring node: poll intake, gate on the public qualifier, authorize per contest policy, score against organizer-held secret refs, publish scores-only — champollion.dev/docs/network/sovereignty/sovereign-eval-node

Subcommands: [`init`](#mt-eval-node-init), [`serve`](#mt-eval-node-serve), [`list`](#mt-eval-node-list), [`approve`](#mt-eval-node-approve), [`deny`](#mt-eval-node-deny), [`run-method`](#mt-eval-node-run-method), [`import-bundle`](#mt-eval-node-import-bundle), [`export-scores`](#mt-eval-node-export-scores), [`relay`](#mt-eval-node-relay), [`stage-request`](#mt-eval-node-stage-request), [`ceremony`](#mt-eval-node-ceremony), [`seal`](#mt-eval-node-seal), [`keygen`](#mt-eval-node-keygen), [`sign-manifest`](#mt-eval-node-sign-manifest), [`verify-manifest`](#mt-eval-node-verify-manifest), [`verdicts`](#mt-eval-node-verdicts), [`bundle`](#mt-eval-node-bundle), [`manifest`](#mt-eval-node-manifest), [`egress-check`](#mt-eval-node-egress-check), [`ledger`](#mt-eval-node-ledger).

### `mt-eval node init`

Write a starter node.json to fill in — every key a scoring node reads, including the public qualifier gate

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Where to write it (default ~/.mt-eval/node.json) |
| `--print` | switch |  | Print the template instead of writing a file |
| `--force` | switch |  | Replace an existing file at that path |
| `--from-contest` | `DIR_OR_MANIFEST` |  | Fill the contest's values from what `contest prepare` wrote: its --out directory or &lt;out>/local/manifest.json (sets, artifacts, qualifier, dev corpus, language pair, test suites). node_id, cards_dir, signing_key and key files stay &lt;...> for you to fill |
| `--contest-id` | `CONTEST_ID` |  | With --from-contest: the contest id entrants use (default: the manifest's contest id — the --slug given to `contest prepare`) |

### `mt-eval node serve`

Run the polling scoring daemon

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path (default ~/.mt-eval/node.json) |
| `--once` | switch |  | One poll pass then exit (cron/test mode) |

### `mt-eval node list`

Show the intake queue this node serves

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |
| `--offline` | switch |  | AIR-GAPPED node: list what `node import-bundle` staged here — status, whether a custodian has approved it, and the next command — from the node's own state and ledger (no database, no service key) |
| `--contest` | `CONTEST` |  | Limit to one contest id (the --slug given to `contest prepare`) |

### `mt-eval node approve`

Custodian: authorize a pending scoring request

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `request_id` | authreq-… id (see `mt-eval node list`) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--actor` | `ACTOR` |  | **Required.** Who is approving (recorded in the audit chain) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |
| `--offline` | switch |  | AIR-GAPPED node: record the approval of an imported proposal HERE — a vote + authorization in the node's hash-chained local ledger and a decision record signed with node.json's signing_key. Refused until the node's own checks have passed for the request (`node run-method <id> --offline` on the pending proposal re-executes the entrant's qualifier on the public dev set and checks a container runtime for a code entry). `node run-method --offline` requires the approval before anything sealed opens. No database, no service key |

| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |

### `mt-eval node run-method`

Execute one authorized T2 method request in the sandbox (--network=none) and publish scores-only (sandbox-evaluation-spec §3/§6–§9)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `request_id` | authreq-… id (see `mt-eval node list`) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--offline` | switch |  | AIRGAPPED mode: run a request staged by `node import-bundle` (no Supabase; scores go out via `node export-scores`). On an entrant's pending proposal no custodian has decided yet, it runs only the node's checks (qualifier re-execution on the public dev set; container runtime for a code entry), records them, and stops for `node approve --offline` |
| `--share` | `SHARE.json` |  | Custodian key-share file (repeat for the quorum). M-of-N ceremony shares unseal the corpus in executor memory; without a quorum the run is refused AND logged (offline mode) |
| `--assert-airgap` | switch |  | Refuse to run unless the egress self-check proves no route out (set on the real node; also node.json airgap.assert_airgap) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |

AIRGAPPED node: stage exported method requests from an exchange directory (digest-verify + static checks now)

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |

AIRGAPPED node: write signed scores-only bundles for every completed run into an exchange directory

|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |

### `mt-eval node relay`

CONNECTED side of a true-airgap contest: verify + publish the signed score bundles the medium carries back, then export authorized method requests to it (that order — the done-marker the first half writes is what keeps a scored request's method tarball off the return drive)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `exchange_dir` | The exchange medium's directory |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |

### `mt-eval node stage-request`

ORGANIZER side, NO database: stage a local method bundle as an AUTHORIZED exchange request (the relay's export shape) for `node import-bundle` — pre-validated exactly as import would, fingerprint bound to node.json's node_id. Scores come back manifest-verifiable, never relay-publishable (no authorization_requests row exists)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` | Method bundle tarball (.tar.gz) built by `mt-eval contest submit-method` |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--contest` | `CONTEST` |  | **Required.** Contest id (the --slug given to `contest prepare`) — must be served by node.json |
| `--out` | `EXCHANGE_DIR` |  | **Required.** Exchange directory to write requests/&lt;id>/ into |
| `--requested-by` | `EMAIL` |  | **Required.** Identity the request row records (the relay export carries the JWT email; staging must say it explicitly) |
| `--corpus-version` | `CORPUS_VERSION` | `v1` | Sealed corpus version bound into the fingerprint (default v1) |
| `--secret-set` | `ID` |  | Sealed set id (default: node.json contests[…].secret_set_id; a mismatch is refused) |
| `--request-id` | `ID` |  | Request id (default: a fresh authreq-…; an existing requests/&lt;id> is never overwritten) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path (its node_id is what the fingerprint binds to) |

### `mt-eval node ceremony`

Key ceremony for a sealed set: generate + split the set key M-of-N on the offline node, distribute shares, verify by test reconstruction, restore only into executor memory — champollion.dev/docs/network/sovereignty/sovereign-eval-node

Subcommands: [`init`](#mt-eval-node-ceremony-init), [`share`](#mt-eval-node-ceremony-share), [`verify`](#mt-eval-node-ceremony-verify), [`restore`](#mt-eval-node-ceremony-restore).

#### `mt-eval node ceremony init`

Generate the set key, split M-of-N, write the public ceremony record + share files; the key itself is zeroed in the same call and never persists

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `DIR` |  | **Required.** Ceremony directory to create |
| `--set` | `SET_ID` |  | **Required.** Sealed-set/card id the key will seal |
| `--group` | `GROUP` |  | **Required.** Custodian group id (recorded on the card) |
| `--quorum`, `--m` | `M` | `3` | Quorum size M — how many custodians must present a share to open the set (default 3). `--m` is an accepted alias |
| `--shares`, `--n` | `N` | `5` | Share count N — how many custodian shares the key is split into (default 5). `--n` is an accepted alias |
| `--custodian` | `CUSTODIANS` |  | Custodian name (repeat n times; defaults to custodian-1..n) |

#### `mt-eval node ceremony share`

List/emit custodian shares from the ceremony dir; copy one to a token with --custodian + --dest; wipe the originals once distribution is verified

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `DIR` |  | **Required.** Ceremony directory |
| `--custodian` | `CUSTODIAN` |  | Which custodian's share to emit |
| `--dest` | `DEST` |  | Copy the share (+ printable .txt) here |
| `--qr` | switch |  | Also render a QR (needs the optional 'qrcode' package) |
| `--all-shares-i-understand` | switch |  | Emit/render EVERY share at once (defeats M-of-N — only for a single-holder recovery you accept the risk of). Normally emit one share per --custodian. |
| `--wipe-originals` | switch |  | Overwrite-then-delete the ceremony dir's share files (after distribution + verify) |

#### `mt-eval node ceremony verify`

Test reconstruction from ≥M shares against the ceremony record — nothing is persisted

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `DIR` |  | **Required.** Ceremony directory (or ceremony.json) |
| `--share` | `SHARES` |  | **Required.** Share file (repeat ≥M times) |

#### `mt-eval node ceremony restore`

Quorum-reconstruction drill: rebuild the key in locked memory, check the commitment, zero it — proves the quorum works without persisting anything

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--share` | `SHARES` |  | **Required.** Share file (repeat ≥M times) |
| `--expect-key-id` | `EXPECT_KEY_ID` |  | Expected key id (e.g. from the sealed artifact or ceremony record) |
| `--i-understand-this-assembles-the-key` | switch |  | Required acknowledgement: `restore` reconstructs the REAL set key in memory (unlike a sealed run, which does it inside the executor and consumes a grant). This standalone drill is unlogged — only run it during a ceremony sitting. |

### `mt-eval node seal`

Seal a corpus to a ceremony's public key: ciphertext artifact + content-free card block; the platform stores ciphertext + metadata, never plaintext (M1)

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--corpus` | `CORPUS` |  | **Required.** Plaintext corpus file |
| `--pubkey` | `PUBKEY` |  | **Required.** Ceremony record / pub.json / base64 SPKI DER |
| `--card-id` | `CARD_ID` |  | **Required.** Sealed-set card id |
| `--group` | `GROUP` |  | **Required.** Custodian group id |
| `--out-dir` | `OUT_DIR` | `.` | Where the artifact + card block are written |
| `--key-scheme` | `KEY_SCHEME` |  | Custody scheme label (defaults to the pubkey file's keyScheme, e.g. shamir-gf256-3-of-5) |

### `mt-eval node keygen`

Generate the node's Ed25519 score-signing keypair (same file format as `champollion network seal-corpus sign-keygen`; publish the .pub.json)

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out` | `OUT` | `.` | Output directory |

### `mt-eval node sign-manifest`

Detached-sign a score manifest (or any payload file) with the node's signing key

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `payload` | File to sign (exact bytes) |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--privkey` | `PRIVKEY` |  | **Required.** score-sign .key.json (or base64 PKCS8 DER) |
| `--sig-out` | `SIG_OUT` |  | Signature path (default &lt;payload>.sig.json) |

### `mt-eval node verify-manifest`

Verify a signed score manifest with the node's PUBLISHED public key — anyone can run this

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `payload` | The manifest file |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sig` | `SIG` |  | Signature file (default &lt;payload>.sig.json) |
| `--pubkey` | `PUBKEY` |  | **Required.** The node's published .pub.json (or base64 DER) |

### `mt-eval node verdicts`

Paired significance for a SEALED contest, computed HERE over the sealed references: every pair of the contest's scored entries, exported as signed verdicts only (p-value, delta, CI, segment count — no text). Feed the file to `contest close --node-verdicts`

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--contest` | `CONTEST` |  | **Required.** Contest id (the --slug given to `contest prepare`) |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  | **Required.** Verdicts file to write (signature: &lt;out>.sig.json) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |
| `--signing-key` | `SIGNING_KEY` |  | The node's score-sign .key.json (default: node.json signing_key) |
| `--metric` | `METRIC` |  | Default: the contest's recorded primary_metric (required on an air-gapped node) |
| `--tie-test` | one of: `ar`, `bootstrap` |  |  |
| `--alpha` | `ALPHA` |  |  |
| `--n-resamples` | `N_RESAMPLES` |  |  |
| `--seed` | `SEED` |  |  |

### `mt-eval node bundle`

Build the offline install bundle on an ONLINE machine (wheels + pinned artifacts + sha256 manifest), or --verify it on the node

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out` | `OUT` |  | Bundle directory to build |
| `--include` | `INCLUDE` |  | Extra artifact file/dir to bundle (repeatable) |
| `--verify` | `DIR` |  | Verify an existing bundle instead of building |
| `--wheel` | `PATH` |  | Bundle this mt-eval-harness wheel instead of the installed release (e.g. a release candidate). Default: your source checkout if you run from one, else the installed version from the package index. |

### `mt-eval node manifest`

IN/OUT drive manifests: write before a crossing, verify after (transfer discipline, node spec §3)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `manifest_action` | write or verify |
| `drive_dir` | The drive's mount/directory |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--direction` | one of: `in`, `out` |  | IN (toward the node) or OUT (scores only) — required for write |
| `--note` | `NOTE` |  | Free-text crossing note |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path (for the node id) |

### `mt-eval node egress-check`

Point-in-time proof this machine has no route out (route table + TCP probes + DNS); the executor runs the same check before a sealed run when assert_airgap is set

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | switch |  | Print the full report as JSON |

### `mt-eval node ledger`

Check the node: verify loads node.json (refusing the first leftover &lt;...> value or declared file that is not on this machine), prints what it checked, then replays the hash-chained local authorization ledger; head prints the ledger's anchorable tip (the value signed into every score manifest)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `ledger_action` | verify or head |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | `PATH` |  | Ledger file (default: the node config's airgap state_dir + authorization-ledger.jsonl) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | Node config path |

## `mt-eval shared-task`

Multi-pair shared-task edition umbrella: one row groups the N per-pair contests of an AmericasNLP-style edition and carries its policy defaults — champollion.dev/docs/network/sovereignty/run-a-sovereign-contest. Grouping + defaults only — every gate stays per-contest

Subcommands: [`create`](#mt-eval-shared-task-create), [`list`](#mt-eval-shared-task-list), [`report`](#mt-eval-shared-task-report).

### `mt-eval shared-task create`

Register a shared-task edition (organizer; needs the contest database's service-role key, MT_EVAL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY), then attach each per-pair contest with `mt-eval contest prepare … --shared-task <id>`

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id` | `ID` |  | **Required.** Stable edition slug, e.g. 'example-task-2026'. One row per edition-YEAR — next year's cycle is a new row, never an edit (046 identity guard) |
| `--name` | `NAME` |  | **Required.** Human-readable edition name |
| `--organizer` | `ORGANIZER` |  | **Required.** The organizing body's own public label (NEVER a key-custodian naming — custodians stay behind the opaque custodian group id) |
| `--year` | `YEAR` |  | **Required.** Cycle year |
| `--authorization-model` | one of: `per-submission`, `blanket`, `open` | `per-submission` | DEFAULT authorization posture copied onto member contests at prepare time (explicit prepare flags win). Default: per-submission (fail-closed) |
| `--intake-daily-limit` | `INTAKE_DAILY_LIMIT` | `5` | DEFAULT per-submitter 24h throttle copied onto member contests at prepare time (default 5) |
| `--description` | `DESCRIPTION` |  | One-paragraph public edition description |

### `mt-eval shared-task list`

List shared-task editions

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--year` | `YEAR` |  | Limit to one cycle year |
| `--all` | switch |  | Include archived editions |

### `mt-eval shared-task report`

Write the edition's Findings-style Markdown report from FROZEN ranking snapshots only (every member contest must be closed) — per-pair rankings with rank ranges and tie evidence, how ties were decided, exclusions, execution facts (reported, never ranked) and the participants' own system descriptions verbatim

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `edition` | Shared-task edition slug, e.g. 'example-task-2026' |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out` | `DIR` |  | **Required.** Directory to write &lt;edition>-findings.md into (created if missing) |
| `--set-url` | `URL` |  | After writing, record where the report is published: PATCHes shared_tasks.report_url + report_generated_at (https only), which is what the public shared-tasks page links to |

## `mt-eval export`

Package a TestReport as a champollion method plugin

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--report` | `REPORT` |  | **Required.** Path to TestReport JSON file (from 'mt-eval test') |
| `--name` | `NAME` |  | **Required.** Plugin name in kebab-case (e.g., 'crk-coached-v1') |
| `--type` | one of: `llm`, `llm-coached`, `api`, `google-translate` |  | **Required.** Method type (must match champollion's valid types) |
| `--locales` | `LOCALES` |  | **Required.** Comma-separated target locale codes (e.g., 'crk' or 'fr,de,es') |
| `--description` | `DESCRIPTION` |  | Human-readable plugin description |
| `--author` | `AUTHOR` |  | Plugin author (e.g., 'Your Name or Org') |
| `--register` | `REGISTER` |  | Target language register/tone (e.g., 'Standard written register') |
| `--coaching-dir` | `COACHING_DIR` |  | Path to coaching data directory to bundle (e.g., '.champollion/coaching') |
| `-o`, `--output-dir` | `OUTPUT_DIR` | `.` | Output directory for the plugin. Default: current directory |
| `--version` | `PLUGIN_VERSION` | `1.0.0` | Semver version string. Default: '1.0.0' |
| `--commercial-ready` | switch |  | Mark this plugin as licensed and cleared for publishing. Default: false (license-unclear). Set when the method's resources have been verified for commercial distribution. |

## `mt-eval project`

Join a project: register yours, list them, offer files, accept offers

Subcommands: [`register`](#mt-eval-project-register), [`list`](#mt-eval-project-list), [`ask`](#mt-eval-project-ask), [`offer`](#mt-eval-project-offer), [`offers`](#mt-eval-project-offers), [`accept`](#mt-eval-project-accept), [`decline`](#mt-eval-project-decline), [`withdraw`](#mt-eval-project-withdraw), [`review`](#mt-eval-project-review).

### `mt-eval project register`
